facts_and_interpretation.subject: Client, queue and service boundary
facts_and_interpretation.facts: C8 p8_runtime records scheduled/offered/started/call-started/finished. Rust statistics labels client_dispatch_wait, write_admission_and_preparation, client_call_to_terminal_including_validation and full offered/scheduled elapsed. StdioRPC explicitly emits backend_queue_ms=None/backend_service_ms=None.
facts_and_interpretation.finding: It would be false to relabel these as pure backend queue or pure backend service. They are the declared observable client/request boundary, including transport/preparation/validation. Original §9 alone does not require a new server request-context architecture as the only admissible way to report queue/service.

facts_and_interpretation.subject: Actual DB acquisition observation
facts_and_interpretation.facts: The original worker control times IndexDb::read_conn, separately times SELECT, and times an independent BEGIN IMMEDIATE;ROLLBACK while actual provider calls are held. It preserves generation equality and a 100ms busy-timeout setting.
facts_and_interpretation.finding: single_read_pool_checkout_us and writer_acquire_and_rollback_us are real acquisition/availability probe elapsed values, not per-MCP pure waiting times. They bound/include acquisition and setup/rollback costs and must keep their exact labels. This is relevant existing evidence for the original DB-lock subject; neither zero wait nor every internal lock's wait distribution is established.

facts_and_interpretation.subject: Worker contention
facts_and_interpretation.facts: Three seeds; actual CodeIndex/post-index worker; 4 held provider attempts and pending work; quiet and held local requests for C1/4/8/16,32 per cell; queue/provider preservation; writer/read progress; write/delete/model-retirement and drain controls.
facts_and_interpretation.finding: This is a real same-source quiet/held worker-contention comparison with raw observations, not absence of any contention evidence. It is fake-provider scheduling/fencing, not live quality/cost. It does not measure successful provider-permit wait or every worker round's service duration, and does not certify stable tails.

facts_and_interpretation.subject: P8-010 applicability
facts_and_interpretation.facts: Original task steps are sustained changes, branch changes, catalog compaction, cache/worker reuse, endpoint reconciliation; acceptance is bounded memory/queues and long-term equality. Its hard predecessor P8-009 transitively includes P8-007.
facts_and_interpretation.finding: The same core evidence must remain source-bound and the dependency must close. No reviewed original clause establishes a separate new requirement to rerun the hour solely to obtain all production-internal C1/4/8/16 attribution fields. Existing soak evidence cannot be relabeled as such fields.

facts_and_interpretation.subject: Assessment of proposed implementation
facts_and_interpretation.facts: The source audit proposes optional request contexts, permit/submission/work boundaries, DB mutex/pool/BEGIN timings, worker-round IDs and provider admission timings across multiple crates.
facts_and_interpretation.finding: Those are plausible deeper diagnostic designs. The source audit correctly says old raw cannot reconstruct them, but the design is more specific than the original acceptance. Their absence alone is not proof that the already registered local/core scope requires that entire product change. Preserve the missing detailed attribution as unknown/unavailable; do not erase existing complementary observations.
